title: Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation: an in-browser research demo on BUSI with external validation
description: Research demo (not for clinical use) of an in-browser ResNet-18 U-Net for breast ultrasound lesion segmentation on the BUSI dataset, with external validation on BUS-BRA and BrEaST. Served model is v1.0.0 INT8 ONNX. Version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23286597. Project by Surabhi Fadnavis. The code, analysis, text, and video were produced with AI tools (Cursor).
